The CF Dogecoin-Dollar Spot Rate (DOGEUSD_RTI) is a once a second benchmark index price for Dogecoin that aggregates order data from Dogecoin-USD markets operated by major cryptocurrency exchanges. Calculated every second, it is the most precise source for Dogecoin pricing and the pre-eminent benchmark for real time valuations being a Registered Benchmark under UK BMR.

The CF Dogecoin-Dollar Spot Rate is the price input for settlement of event contracts and prediction markets offered by Kalshi, and ForecastEX.
